filesystem.rule: Retain all original files, private credentials/SDDL rollback packages, source layouts, complete and failed backups, tar/dump/image bundles, signed binaries, approvals, raw scans, audit logs, model ledgers and approved archives. No filesystem deletion or move proposed.

global_reference_evidence.boundary: These are conservative union references, not a zero-reference eligibility test. Unknown/shared/other-project/system resources remain retained. Image IDs may denote OCI index/platform/config depending on engine; RootFS gives uncompressed DiffIDs, not all compressed content-store descriptors. No complete shared-layer exclusivity or multiarch graph proof is claimed; never use image/tag deletion or prune to infer safe layer GC.
